children: has priced a combined offering of $25 billion in Class A common stock and $12.5 billion in depositary shares tied to mandatory convertible preferred stock, upsizing the common stock portion from its previously announced $22.5 billion.
Meta has granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 37.5 million depositary shares at the offering price, minus underwriting discounts, to cover any over-allotments.
The net proceeds from the Depositary Shares Offering will be approximately $12.5 billion after deducting the applicable underwriting discount and estimated offering expenses payable by Meta.
Meta intends to use the net proceeds from the Depositary Shares Offering for general corporate purposes.

title: Meta prices upsized $37.5B stock and depositary share offering
